Name: Dream Cellar
Author: Lucidvisionsinc
Description:
Step into the ultimate farming upgrade with the [b]Dream Cellar[/b], a multi-level space perfect for aging artisan goods and creating your dream production area.
[list]
[*][b]Place Casks Freely[/b]: use casks to age wine, cheese, and more.
[*][b]Custom Design[/b]: Enter through a handcrafted hardwood doorway that leads to two unique levels—a warm wooden floor on the first level and a sturdy stone floor on the second.
[*][b]Functional Features[/b]: Includes a water refill area for convenience, ideal for watering crops or decorative plants.
[*][b]Dark to Light[/b]: The cellar starts dark, allowing you to customize the lighting to suit your style and create the perfect atmosphere.
[/list]
Build your own Dream Cellar with Robin for 8,000 gold. The construction requires 25 Hardwood, 50 Stone, and 50 Copper Bars.

This mod uses the solid foundations mod so be sure you download it as it won't work without it.



Credits:
Artwork and design by dreamygloom
